_comment: Ondes VOXEL original structure, not Minecraft content. Descriptive only: this folder is not a vanilla resource type, so a vanilla server given this datapack ignores it (a worldgen/structure_set naming an unknown structure would refuse the whole pack). The generator's constants are src/ov_worldgen/src/great_pyramid_plan.cpp, and test_great_pyramid keeps the two equal. See docs/provenance/grande-pyramide.md.
